title: Protocol B
selection_exposition: Immediately after Rico confronts Sigmund over Anne and D Block, Committee B triggers a purge inside Nortune.<New>With records vanishing and workers trapped below, Rico's anger is tested by the lives that now depend on his judgment.<Close>
blocks:
CHAPTER 5
PROTOCOL B<New>Committee Control, Nortune.<Close>

Sigmund
Anne's offsite copies are secure.
Seize the remaining source archive,
remove every Committee restriction,
and stop the purge.<Close>

ARCHIVIST
The request has been linked to the
buried vessel transfer.<New>I'm receiving a protected-channel
response.<Close>
[Rue Cohen appears on the monitor.]<Close>

Rue
Kaiser Sigmund, I am asking you to
withdraw both orders.<Close>

Sigmund
On what grounds?<Close>

Rue
A sealed personal record and vessel
succession authority were accessed
under one executive signature.<New>B Protocol identifies that pattern
as seizure of protected state assets.<Close>

Sigmund
I issued both orders. There has been
no seizure.<Close>

Rue
B Protocol does not evaluate
intention. It evaluates risk.<Close>

<Rico>
Then shut it off and let him finish.<Close>

Rue
The protocol cannot be suspended by
the authority it is designed to
restrain.<Close>

ARCHIVIST
The sealed archive is being purged.
The lower bulkheads have closed.<New>Worker lifts have lost reserve power.
Battling has been given priority.<Close>

<Bart>
They took power from trapped workers
to keep the arena lit?<Close>

Rue
Battling is Nortune's largest point
of civilian assembly.<New>Public continuity must be preserved
during an executive crisis.<Close>

<Rico>
You locked workers below ground so
the arena could stay bright.<Close>

Rue
Restricted crews were instructed to
remain at their stations.<Close>

<Fei>
They cannot reach the lifts. They
aren't at their stations. They're
trapped.<Close>

Sigmund
Suspend every Committee credential.
Open the manual evacuation routes.<New>Cut the arena broadcast and send its
reserve power to the worker lifts.<Close>

ARCHIVIST
The local relays refuse central
commands.<Close>

Sigmund
Then isolate them one at a time. Do
not wait for Committee authorization.<Close>

Rue
Interference will activate the buried
defense system.<Close>

Sigmund
Rue Cohen, you diverted emergency
power and confined Nortune citizens.<New>Your access is revoked. Stand down.<Close>

Rue
Your revocation has been entered into
the record.<Close>

[Three locked relays appear on the
facility map.]<Close>

<Bart>
Three relays, three of us. Almost
considerate of them.<Close>

<Rico>
We stay together. These halls were
built to keep people apart.<New>I'm not giving them what they want.<Close>

RELAY 1
ARCHIVE INTEGRITY<Close>

<Fei>
Anne's copies are safe. The records
still inside this partition are not.<Close>

<Bart>
I can stop the purge or copy what is
left. I cannot do both from here.<Close>

Rue
A limited recovery channel is open.
Select one priority record.<Close>

<Rico>
You mean choose who gets erased.<Close>

[Rico studies a list of sealed
workers, prisoners, demi-humans and
former Battlers.]<Close>

<Rico>
Copy all of them.<Close>

Rue
The available bandwidth is
insufficient.<Close>

<Bart>
Fei can hold the archive line while
I split the copy across maintenance.<New>Someone has to reset the purge
counter by hand.<Close>

<Rico>
Tell me which switch.<Close>

<Fei>
The remaining sealed records will be
lost if the line drops.<Close>

<Rico>
Then we keep it from dropping.<New>They did not hide only one person in
here.<Close>

Rue
Restoring invalid classifications
will disrupt housing, medical, and
ration records.<Close>

<Rico>
Then those records can be corrected.
Erasing the people was never a
correction.<Close>

<Bart>
Copy complete. Every sealed entry
this partition still held is here.<Close>

<Rico>
Send one set to Sigmund. Send the
rest somewhere Committee B cannot
reach.<Close>

<Bart>
Already doing both.<Close>

RELAY 2
EMERGENCY DISTRIBUTION<Close>

WORKER
Control, this is Level Eight. The
south gate is sealed.<New>Air pumps are slowing and we have
injured men down here.<Close>

<Rico>
How many at the lift?<Close>

WORKER
More than the cage can carry.
Everyone moved when the lights died.<Close>

<Bart>
The arena has floodlights, music, and
enough reserve to run every worker
lift twice.<Close>

<Fei>
Can we move it without overloading
the grid?<Close>

<Bart>
Hold the regulator while I cut the
broadcast feed.<Close>

Rue
An uncontrolled evacuation risks
crowd compression at upper stations.<New>The workers should remain until
security establishes an orderly route.<Close>

<Rico>
Their air is running out. We will
make the route orderly ourselves.<Close>

<Rico>
Level Eight, listen carefully.<New>Families and injured workers take
the first cage. North crew takes the
second.<New>Everyone else stays clear until the
green lamp comes on.<Close>

WORKER
The signal panel is dead.<Close>

<Bart>
Watch the Battling sign above the
shaft.<New>When it goes dark, your lamp will
turn green.<Close>

<Rico>
Repeat the order to every level. No
pushing, and nobody gets left alone.<Close>

[The arena goes dark. The worker
lifts begin to move.]<Close>

WORKER
The green lamp is on. First cage is
moving.<Close>

<Bart>
Never thought I would improve Nortune
by shutting down Battling.<Close>

<Rico>
Keep the lifts moving. One relay
left.<Close>

RELAY 3
COMBAT TELEMETRY<Close>

ARCHIVIST
The buried defense Gear has begun its
launch cycle.<New>Its targeting archive is active.<Close>

<Bart>
What did they train it on?<Close>

ARCHIVIST
Stier. Every official match, test,
and recorded response from Rico's
Gear.<Close>

<Rico>
You kept all of it.<Close>

Rue
Stier supplied Nortune's most reliable
predictive combat model.<Close>

<Fei>
If Rico fights as he did in the arena,
it will know what comes next.<Close>

<Bart>
Then we do not fight it that way.<Close>

ARCHIVIST
There is time for one command. Corrupt
the combat library, or release the
lower bulkheads.<Close>

<Rico>
Open the bulkheads.<Close>

<Fei>
Rico...<Close>

<Rico>
The workers do not get another chance
if those doors stay shut.<New>We do.<Close>

<Bart>
Bulkheads first. We will handle the
machine.<Close>

Rue
That decision lowers your projected
survival considerably.<Close>

<Rico>
Your projections put living people
behind sealed doors.<New>I'm done letting them decide for me.<Close>

[The bulkheads turn green. The
defense Gear launches.]<Close>

<Fei>
It is tracking Stier before you move.<Close>

<Rico>
Then don't wait for me.<New>Fei, draw its upper guns. Bart, keep
it from planting its right foot.<Close>

<Bart>
That sounds more like a plan.<Close>

Rue
Stier's opening attack identified.
Counter sequence prepared.<Close>

<Rico>
That opening came from the arena.<New>I'm not alone in the arena anymore.<Close>

[Fei draws the machine's fire. Bart
breaks its stance. Rico attacks from
a direction no solitary Battler could
have created.]<Close>

Rue
Prediction confidence: thirty-two
percent. Recalculating.<Close>

<Rico>
Don't give it time.<Close>

[The defense Gear falls. Committee
Control opens.]<Close>

Rue
I am recording this as unauthorized
destruction of state property.<Close>

Sigmund
End the purge and step away from the
console.<Close>

Rue
Civil order was preserved. The
projected loss was confined to a
limited industrial population--<Close>

<Rico>
Don't finish that sentence.<New>I've heard men turn a person into a
number before deciding what could be
done to him.<Close>

Rue
Every system requires an acceptable
threshold of loss.<Close>

Sigmund
You did not govern Nortune.<New>You selected the people you believed
Nortune could afford to lose.<Close>

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Rue Cohen, you are under arrest for
unlawful confinement, destruction of
records, and activation of a defense
weapon inside the city.<Close>

Rue
Committee B will not recognize this
arrest.<Close>

Sigmund
Then it may dispute the charges in a
public tribunal.<New>The archive and evacuation records
will be presented in full.<Close>

<Rico>
Don't use the lower cells. People are
still coming through that sector.<Close>

SECURITY CAPTAIN
We will hold her in the administrative
wing.<Close>

Rue
After everything I have done, you are
concerned with where I am confined?<Close>

<Rico>
It isn't for you.<New>Enough doors have been locked on the
people below us today.<Close>

UPPER STATION
FINAL LIFT TRANSPONDER: VERIFIED
ALL CREWS: ACCOUNTED FOR<New>SEALED ARCHIVE COPY: SECURE<Close>

Sigmund
Rico... I could not have done this
without you.<Close>

<Rico>
Help the injured first. Return those
records to the people they belong to.<New>When this place is steady, we can
talk.<Close>

Sigmund
All right.<Close>

<Rico>
Fei, Bart, come on. The lift crews
will need hands.<Close>
CHAPTER 5 COMPLETE<Close>
